comment: Gate G-R on the rented machine (md/GR.md, sections 7 and 8; md/PLAN.md, entries of 6 Oct 2026, 5:00 and 8:56 AM IST). gr_check_x: point X again from the atomic guess, against the Pi's energy. gr_points: the single points that the Pi has not finished, with the Pi's own queue program (md/qm/gr_queue.py) and the machine's configuration (md/qm/gr/queue_vm.json): finished points are skipped, the others are computed in the order of md/qm/gr/points.json; its success test asks for every point of the list as it is NOW, so points added to the list are computed by the next attempt. gr_relax_Rx, gr_relax_X: the relaxed references of part B (the ligand relaxed with zinc and imidazoles fixed, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-31G*, geomeTRIC), one after the other, after the single points; each is done when it has converged or when the configuration at N2 has crossed to the other one (state crossed: stopped there, reported). 7 CPUs and 7 threads, not 8: the runner counts one CPU for the GPU task, and 16 (qm_opt, qm_hess) + 1 + 8 would be 25 of 24, so a task with 8 would wait for every GPU task and, once running, keep every GPU task waiting. To restart a task of this file with new code or new points: touch /root/cqc-sfa-md/qm/gr/STOP (the SCF or the optimisation stops at its next cycle or step and keeps its orbitals or its geometry; the runner starts the task again after 20 to 30 s and the command removes the file). To end one: queue.py cancel ID. gr_binding, gr_binding_final: the binding check as soon as the optimisation of the small model has ended (qm_opt), and again when the file of MCPB.py step 2s exists (qm_write); exit code 1 of the check (failed) is a result, not a failure of the task.

tasks.title: (g0) gate G-R, machine against Pi: point X again from the atomic guess, in its own folder; the two energies must agree within 1e-7 Hartree
command: 'agree': bool(abs(d) < 1e-7 and pi['xyz_sha256'] == vm['xyz_sha256'] and vm['converged'] and pi['host'] != vm['host'])}
f"machine: {vm['scf_cycles']} cycles from the atomic guess, {vm['wall_seconds']:.0f} s with {vm['threads']} threads")

tasks.title: (g1) gate G-R: the single points the Pi has not finished (md/qm/gr/queue_vm.json; d2 and Nx before the turns about N2-S), table and gate numbers after every point

(g2) gate G-R part B: the ligand relaxed from Rx with zinc and imidazoles fixed, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/6-31G*, geomeTRIC; the signed volume at N2 is recorded at every step, and the run stops if it changes sign
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$GR_SMALL/relax/qm_Rx.json" state=done || python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$GR_SMALL/relax/qm_Rx.json" state=crossed

tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$GR_SMALL/relax/qm_X.json" state=done || python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$GR_SMALL/relax/qm_X.json" state=crossed

tasks.title: (g4) binding check of gate G-R: force-field minimum of the small model against its quantum-chemical optimum (provisional: the geometry of the finished optimisation); one line into the log of the gate, then the gate tables again
command: [ "$rc" -le 1 ] || { echo "binding check: exit code $rc (2: no optimum yet)"; exit 1; }
